sentences.en: Society must do away with laws which cause racial discrimination.
sentences.zh: 社会必须废除导致种族歧视的法律。

sentences.en: He is not a person who has strong racial prejudice.
sentences.zh: 他不是一个有强烈种族偏见的人。

sentences.en: The separatists seem to be convinced of their racial superiority.
sentences.zh: 分离主义者似乎确信自己的种族优越性。
